_comment: Team-shared hook config. Personal overrides go in hooks-config.local.json (gitignored), which is merged over this file. See ../HOOKS-README.md.
_enforcement: The part that makes rules self-enforcing. Turning this off leaves every rule a reminder again.
_sounds: Off by default: no audio ships with this repo. See ../sounds/README.md to add your own.
_perEvent: Set any of these true to silence one event without disabling the rest.
_killSwitch: Silences every event including enforcement. settings.local.json's disableAllHooks does the same at the harness level.
